0.title: Course Introduction
0.content:
Anjou is a region famous for Chenin Blanc, but its Cabernet Franc is just as good. From the entry-level Anjou Rouge, to the selected Anjou-Villages, to the summit Anjou-Brissac, and Saumur's greatest Saumur-Champigny — these five AOCs make up the complete spectrum of Anjou-Saumur reds.

Learning Objectives

🍷 Master the Anjou red AOC hierarchy

The quality differences and rules of Anjou, Anjou-Villages and Anjou-Brissac

🏰 Know Saumur-Champigny

Cabernet Franc on tuffeau, and why it is called the most elegant red of the Loire
1.title: Anjou Rouge — Introduction to Anjou Reds
1.highlights.0.content: Mainly Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon, a little Gamay permitted, light to medium body
1.highlights.1.content: Strictly limited to Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon, higher quality, mainly from schist-soil villages
1.highlights.2.content: The top village of Anjou-Villages, in Brissac-Quincé, mixed schist and sandstone soils, better structure
1.content:
The three levels of Anjou reds represent different pursuits of quality:

Anjou Rouge: everyday drinking, flexible blends, fresh fruit, suited to drinking young.

Anjou-Villages: selected villages, pure Cabernet, with more minerality and ageing potential.

Anjou-Brissac: top expression, with Brissac's distinctive schist slopes creating complex structure and spicy notes.

3.title: Saumur Rouge and Saumur-Champigny
3.highlights.0.content: Saumur's basic red, tuffeau soils, light and elegant, Cabernet Franc-led
3.highlights.1.content: Saumur's best red region, on an ancient tuffeau plateau, where Cabernet Franc shows red fruit, florals and silky tannins
3.content:
Saumur-Champigny is the king of Anjou-Saumur reds. This small appellation lies southeast of Saumur, planted on an ancient tuffeau plateau.

Typical style: fresh fruit of raspberry, strawberry and violet, silky tannins, crisp acidity, and a slight tuffeau minerality.

The best vintages can age 10–15 years, evolving in complexity with leather, tobacco and spice. Representative estate: Clos Rougeard (one of the Loire's most legendary reds).

5.title: Quiz
5.questions.0.question: What is the main grape variety of Saumur-Champigny?
5.questions.0.explanation: Saumur-Champigny is led by Cabernet Franc, and its tuffeau soils give it a distinctive light, elegant style.
